answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and enter a Semaphore identity tree; an epoch polynomial commits to each RLN rate-limit secret, while polynomial identity proofs bind messages to unique nullifiers. One message per epoch is permitted. If an agent sends a duplicate, two valid shares at the same evaluation point enable Shamir reconstruction of its private key, triggering immediate collateral slashing. Thus a Sybil island is cut off at the inlet before contaminating the river.
